Dark Ether Charges last 5? seconds and can be detonated by shooting or coming into contact with them.

Detonations deal <pve ALot™ /> <pvp [?] /> elemental damage in a ? meter radius and match the weapon's element. Damage is always attributed to the Charge's creator regardless of who destroys them.

Detonating Charges <title refills [G_refill] /> and overfills the magazines of all equipped Dark Eather Reaper weapons from reserves up to 140% capacity (rounded up).
